demo_extraction.scope_summary: Develop a Hospital Management Information System for four tertiary hospitals. Cover patient registration, pharmacy, laboratory and billing modules. Provide on-site support at each hospital for twelve months.

eligibility.requirement: Valid NTN and active ATL status
eligibility.source_quote: The bidder must hold a valid National Tax Number (NTN) and appear on the FBR Active Taxpayers List (ATL).

eligibility.requirement: Minimum average annual turnover of PKR 50 million over the last three years.
eligibility.source_quote: Minimum average annual turnover of PKR 50 million over the last three years.

eligibility.requirement: The bidder must have been in business for at least 5 years.

HL7 or FHIR integration capability must be demonstrated in the technical proposal.
Prior HMIS deployment in a tertiary care hospital is preferred.
A registered office in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa is preferred.
Affidavit on stamp paper that the bidder has not been blacklisted by any government body.
Bid security in the form of a pay order or bank guarantee shall accompany the financial bid.
